hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler Finance vaults. In `beforeSwap`, it computes quotes via a bonding-curve invariant, deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and returns a `BeforeSwapDelta` to handle all pool accounting directly—bypassing standard Uniswap concentrated liquidity.
